body.x: GOYANG, Korea (AVING Special Report on 'KES 2006') -- <Visual News> Samsung Electronics presented ''Anycall Fx(model: SPH-M4500)'', 18.9mm-thick slim slide smartphone equipped with PDA, wireless (802.11 b/g), terrestrial DMB service. It features Window Mobile v 5.0 for Pocket PC O/S, 520MHz CPU, 2.0 megafixel camera, VGA sub-camera and 2.4-inch touch screen. It also supports 5.1 channel stereo sound, micro SD exterior memory slot, VOD/MOD/MP3 player and video clip editing functions. Additionally, MS Pocket Office and Outlook are available equivalent to existing PDA. Nespot Swing service enables users to connected internet by wireless LAN. It adapted ''Ahnlap mobile security'', a mobile anti-virus software for the first time.
